events.title: Demo Update: Fixes & Polish
events.summary: A small update to make your workday run more smoothly: Fixed save issues that could block starting a personal task after older company history was cleared. Fixed staff movement and coffee breaks falling behind when fast-forwarding the workday. Improved report navigation, staff level-up feedback, and planner layout. events.summary: Unfortunately, the latest build was not really what we (and our players!) thought Void Inc should be and the release had a lot of issues and pain points. Thanks for your patience, I'm always looking to improve!Most of these are built around a smoother first day, clearer feedback, and a little more atmosphere around the office.Here's the changes we've completed today:Expanded opening experience: Explore an updated lobby and hallway with new environmental details and a few things to discover.Easie
